subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that V/STOL shipboard recovery pattern is safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.7.1.3 Shipboard recovery pattern. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, design, test, or configuration documentation.

Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 while performing the Shipboard Recovery Pattern MTE as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Suggested MTE Handling Qualities Evaluation Tasks for V/STOL Operations table. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of the entire shipboard recovery pattern from fully wingborne flight through semi-jetborne flight and culminating in either deceleration to hover and VL or deceleration to SRVL approach speed and SRVL, to evaluate air vehicle capabilities, to include: a. Single air vehicle recovery pattern, including all subtasks (break turn, conversion from wingborne to semi-jetborne on downwind, turn to final, final deceleration to hover or SRVL speed, hover translation/VL or SRVL). b. Recovery pattern while in formation with other air vehicle for some percentage of the pattern. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess handling qualities, control strategy, overall workload, cognitive error potential for the entire shipboard recovery pattern related to all procuring agency requirements, including configurations and loadings, winds, sea states, day and night, VMC and IMC, solo recoveries, and formation recoveries. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities, control strategy, overall workload, cognitive error potential for the entire shipboard recovery pattern related to all procuring agency requirements, for selected combinations of configurations and loadings, winds, sea states, day and night, VMC and IMC, solo recoveries, and formation recoveries.
